description: Somos un equipo unido por la curiosidad y la ciencia. En NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 desarrollamos AGROHELIOS, una propuesta que utiliza datos satelitales de la NASA para estudiar eventos climáticos extremos y sus efectos en la agricultura. Queremos convertir información científica en conocimiento accesible, conectar los datos con las experiencias de las comunidades y aprender juntos. Nos emociona este reto y queremos representar a Colombia con creatividad, compromiso y pasión por la ciencia.
summary:
AGROHELIOS

From Space to Earth: Science That Cares for Agriculture.

AGROHELIOS is an interactive web platform that brings climate information and agricultural knowledge closer to society. It allows users to explore environmental data through interactive maps and visualizations, helping them understand the climatic conditions of different territories.

It also features an educational section about the environmental requirements of different crops and their growing conditions, alongside an experiences section connecting climate patterns with the real-life experiences of farming communities.

This version focuses on climate monitoring and agricultural education. Crop rotation comparison is planned for the next development phase.

Our purpose is to transform environmental information into accessible knowledge, helping people better understand our land and support more informed agricultural decisions.
details:
Project Details – AGROHELIOS

AGROHELIOS is a technological innovation project focused on agriculture, satellite observation, and environmental analysis. It is an interactive web platform that integrates remote sensing tools and data visualization to support the monitoring and understanding of agricultural territories worldwide.

The platform incorporates technologies and tools such as NDVI, infrared imagery and vegetation. It also features a historical data section, educational resources about crop growth requirements, and a community experiences section that connects environmental information with the real-life experiences of farming communities.

As part of its development, a region in Colombia was selected for an in-depth analysis to demonstrate the platform's capabilities through a practical case study.

AGROHELIOS is designed for farmers, students, researchers, and the general public, aiming to make scientific and satellite-based knowledge more accessible and support better-informed agricultural decisions.
